Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full comfort-system-health payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your comfort system checkup","score":82,"scoreLabel":"Good","statusText":"One item needs attention soon","updatedText":"Checked today","systems":[{"label":"Furnace","status":"good","detail":"Operating normally","icon":"furnace"},{"label":"AC condenser","status":"watch","detail":"Coil could use a cleaning","icon":"ac"},{"label":"Thermostat","status":"good","detail":"Firmware up to date","icon":"thermostat"},{"label":"Air filter","status":"due","detail":"Replace within a week","icon":"filter"}],"filter":{"lifePct":18,"daysLeft":6,"label":"20x25x1 filter"},"nextServiceText":"Next maintenance due Nov 3","recommendationText":"Book a tune-up to clean the AC coil before summer.","submitText":"Book maintenance","submitValue":"I'd like to book a maintenance visit"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Your comfort system checkup'.
- 'score' (number, REQUIRED, 0-100): overall comfort-system health; rendered as a radial gauge. The gauge is green at 80+, amber at 50-79, red below 50. If omitted the card shows its built-in sample.
- 'scoreLabel' (string, optional): short label under the score (e.g. 'Good'). Derived from the score when omitted.
- 'statusText' (string, optional): one short summary line under the gauge.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): small 'checked' timestamp shown by the title.
- 'systems' (array, optional): per-system rows. Each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED); 'status' (string, REQUIRED — one of good | watch | due | fault; drives the pill + rail color); 'detail' (string, optional — one short line); 'icon' (string, optional — one of furnace | ac | thermostat | ductwork | filter | heatpump | water_heater; drives the glyph) }.
- 'filter' (object, optional): the air-filter life bar — { 'lifePct' (number 0-100, REQUIRED within filter — the bar fill; green above 50, amber 20-50, red below 20); 'daysLeft' (number, optional); 'label' (string, optional — e.g. filter size) }. Omit the whole object to hide the bar.
- 'nextServiceText' (string, optional): a scheduling callout, e.g. next maintenance due date.
- 'recommendationText' (string, optional): a one-line recommendation callout.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): CTA label; defaults to nothing (no button). 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back when tapped; defaults to submitText.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
